title: Civilians killed in DRC fighting, a day after peace deal signing
content: Children are among several killed in fighting in the DRC, a day after the signing of US-backed peace deal.

title: At Doha Forum, Qatar PM warns Gaza ceasefire is at ‘critical moment’
content: Qatar’s PM says Gaza talks are at a 'critical moment,' stressing the current arrangement is a pause, not full ceasefire.

title: Colombia signs peace-building deal in Qatar with Clan del Golfo drug gang
content: Colombia signed a peace-building agreement in Qatar with the Clan del Golfo, Colombia's largest drug-trafficking group.

title: Chad struggles as new Sudanese refugees strain resources and infrastructure
content: Sudan's civil war drives millions from their homes, creating an unparalleled humanitarian emergency in the region.

title: EU’s Kallas says Washington ‘biggest ally’ despite US security downgrade
content: Foreign policy chief keeping Washington onside as Ukrainian, US officials continue talks on ending Russia-Ukraine war.

title: RSF alleges SAF forces struck crucial border crossing in Sudan near Chad
content: The RSF accused Sudan's army of the attack on a vital corridor for aid and Sudanese fleeing the war.

title: Oklahoma rack up 14th straight NBA win; Durant hits 31K career points
content: Gilgeous-Alexander scores 33 points in Thunder's win over the Mavericks while Houston Rockets beat Phoenix Suns.

title: IAEA flags damage to Chornobyl nuclear plant’s protective shield in Ukraine
content: The IAEA has found a drone degraded the shield in February, in a strike Ukraine has accused Russia of carrying out.

title: Heavy rains hamper recovery as death toll from floods in Asia exceeds 1,750
content: Hundreds more people are still missing as intensive rains pose new dangers in Indonesia and Sri Lanka.

title: Thousands protest in Berlin against new German military conscription bill
content: Politicians approve the controversial law after months of heated debate, amid fears over a potential war with Russia.

title: Arab, Muslim nations reject Israel exit-only plan for Gaza’s Rafah crossing
content: Ministers slam Israeli breach of truce and its exit plan which aims to 'displace Palestinian people from their land'.

title: Doha Forum 2025 live: Gaza ceasefire not complete – Qatari PM
content: World leaders, high-level diplomats and business executives take part in annual platform held in Qatar's capital.

title: Palestinian groups express ‘grave concerns’ over Marwan Barghouti’s safety
content: Palestinians express alarm following 'intimidating' call to family of imprisoned leader alleging new abuse.

title: Canada removes Syria from list of states that support ‘terrorism’
content: Ottawa cites similar move by US as well as Syrian government's efforts to advance stability in the country.

title: Australia sanctions Afghan Taliban officials over women’s rights abuses
content: Canberra said the Taliban officials are guilty of oppressing women and girls, as well as 'undermining good governance'.
